contexts.text: The waters out of the sanctuary () = the life and mercy of the Lord, who is the sanctuary. 109[end].
Love is meant by His sanctuary in the midst of them (). ( = conjunction through love and faith. AC 6804:9.)
Who were not to be admitted into the sanctuary, that is, into the Lord's Kingdom.
The sanctuary of truth in the Divine Human. Signified, Explained.

It is the veriest Divine good and truth in the Lord's Divine Human, with which the truth from the human was conjoined, which was signified by the sanctuary, which was the holy of holies in the tabernacle, and in the temple; and its quality was represented by the things therein... This was the very holy of holies, or the sanctuary of truth.
The sanctuary () = celestial love; in the supreme sense, the Lord's Divine Human, from which is this love.
His sanctuary () = where is the Divine truth in which is Divine good. ( = the Lord's Divine Human. AC 9594:5.) ( = everything of the Church. AC 10248:3.)
Thy hands, Lord, have prepared a sanctuary () = Heaven where are those who are in the truth of faith from the Lord. A sanctuary = Heaven where is the truth of faith.

As to a sanctuary, in the supreme sense, it = the truth of faith which is from the Lord; and thence, in the representative sense, the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom, and also the Spiritual Church; and thence a regenerated man; thus, in the abstract sense, the truth of faith, thus faith itself... Hence Heaven is called a sanctuary, from the truth of faith which is from the Lord. Illustrated.
The place of My sanctuary () = Heaven and the Church, and also the Word.

They shall make for Me a sanctuary () = a representative of the Lord, thus of Heaven... because it was the tabernacle, which could not be a sanctuary except through the representation. For a sanctuary is the Holy itself, and nothing is holy except what is Divine... That Heaven is a sanctuary, is because Heaven is Heaven from the Divine there... AC 10098:end.

That a sanctuary, in the supreme sense, = the Lord... and that a sanctuary = Heaven and also the Church; and that sanctuaries = those things in Heaven and the Church which are from the Lord. Illustrated.
Sanctuaries () = the things which are of the Church.
The sanctuary () = everything of the Church as to truth.
That light was from the sanctuary of the tabernacle of their worship... Within that sanctuary was a tablet...
In the midst of their sacred edifices there is a sanctuary, where in an ark, lies the (Ancient) Word...
Reasons which are in the Lord's sanctuary.
The sanctuary from which they should begin () = the Church as to the good of love and truth of faith.
Strength and beauty are in His sanctuary () = (Divine good and Divine truth in) the Church.
The habitation of his sanctuary was cast forth () = the vastation of the Church.
In the sanctuary () = Heaven and the Church where is Divine truth.
Sanctuary is said of the Church as to truths.
His sanctuary () = the Holy itself of Heaven and the Church ( = in the supreme sense, the Lord Himself; and, in the relative sense, the worship of Him from the good of love. AE 433:24.)
The sanctuary () = the Church.
To tread down the sanctuary () = to destroy the truths of doctrine from the Word.
The sanctuary () = the Church.
Heaven and the Church are called a sanctuary () from the good of love; and a habitation, from the truths of that good.
The enemy hath destroyed all things in the sanctuary () = that evil has destroyed the holy things of the Church.
The sanctuary which He will profane () = the Word from which is the Church; for this is the sanctuary itself, because it is Divine truth.
My sanctuary () = the truth of Heaven and the Church.
His advent is meant by, His steps in the sanctuary ().
Divine truth is not holy until it is in its ultimate, (which) is the Word in the sense of the letter; and therefore Divine truth there is holy, and may be called the sanctuary, Explained.
Holy Spirit. 5. 4. Hence the place in the tabernacle where the ark was... was called the sanctuary, and the holy of holies.
